about_the_game:
Grow. Harvest. Survive the Crash.

Farmers Market is a strategic farming and market simulator where crops behave like stocks—and prices never sit still. Design your farm by placing plots where you want, expand your land to increase capacity, and play the market to turn harvests into profit. Buy low, sell high, and protect your margins from bugs, crows, and weeds.

It’s cozy… until it isn’t. The economy can crash at any time—and your next harvest might not even cover what you spent on tools to grow it. Meet tough financial goals under pressure or risk falling behind in this blend of economic sim, business sim, and resource management challenge.

🧠 Strategic Farming Meets a Dynamic Economy

Every decision matters. Do you place more plots and scale up early? Wait for prices to spike? Harvest everything before the economy takes a dive? With limited capital, constrained space you can gradually expand, and shifting prices, Farmers Market rewards careful planning, sharp timing, and long-term thinking.

🌿 Key Features

  • 🌱 Place plots and design your layout to suit your strategy

  • 🗺️ Expand your farm’s footprint to increase production and unlock new possibilities

  • 💹 Buy, sell, and trade crops in a dynamic, real-time economy

  • 🐛 Defend your fields from bugs, crows, and invasive weeds

  • ⏱️ Time your buying, selling, and harvests to maximize profits

  • 💰 Hit financial targets to unlock tools, expand plots, and earn upgrades

  • 🎲 Adapt to random economic events that shake up crop prices

  • 🔧 Upgrade tools to automate production and gain a market edge

  • 📉 Survive market crashes with smart hedges, buffers, and backup plans

  • 👀 Watch the economy swing—sometimes in your favor… sometimes not

Will you outsmart the market—or get left behind?
📬 Add to your Wishlist and be ready when the market surges—or crashes.

📌 Notes from the Developer

Solo-developed by Aimee Harper

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+ or Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual Core or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD 3000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Mouse, keyboard
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.4 GHz Dual Core or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (e.g., NVIDIA GeForce 600 series or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster load times
